title: Fail-Fast Mount Harness and Accessible Browser Matrix Suite
description: Follow-up of wave 1127 proposal items 4 and 5 (ticket 26/11/13 FLEET-ONE-MACHINE-SHARED-HOT-CACHE-AND-REMOTE-EXECUTION). (1) Cheap fail-fast harness for tests that mount the full app: boot only what the test touches, a deadline per phase, abort at the first failure with a precise bilingual (en, de) reason. (2) Turn the browser interaction matrix into a maintained parallel test suite that finds elements by accessible names and roles (no CSS/xpath selectors), dispatched across idle fleet workers through the existing repo test-file / suite offload (H44/H50). Done = one app's mount tests run in under a minute locally with fail-fast behaviour, and its browser matrix runs as a suite in parallel on at least 2 workers with results identical to local, written up in the ticket folder.
